serverName                       ols-cpanel-lab
user                             nobody
group                            nobody
autoRestart                      1
enableChroot                     0
inMemBufSize                     60M
swappingDir                      /run/ols-cpanel/lshttpd/swap
statDir                          /run/ols-cpanel/status
shmDefaultDir                    /run/ols-cpanel/shm/
gracefulRestartTimeout           300
mime                             conf/mime.properties

adminEmails                      root@localhost
indexFiles                       index.html
disableWebAdmin                  1

enableUpdateCheck                0

errorlog logs/error.log {
    logLevel             INFO

}
accessLog logs/access.log {
    rollingSize          10M

tuning {
    maxConnections       200
    maxSSLConnections    200
    # HTTP/3 (FV-04): QUIC on the HTTPS listeners (UDP beside TCP, listener key enableQuic, default 1). Its shared
    # state lives under /run/ols-cpanel like every other (RV-30), never in a world-writable directory; the
    # compiler writes quicEnable 0 and enableQuic 0 when the operator opted out (/var/lib/ols-cpanel/http3.json).
    quicEnable           1

    # default). Brotli where the client offers it, gzip otherwise; compressed static copies kept up to date.
    enableGzipCompress   1
    enableDynGzipCompress 1
    gzipCompressLevel    6
    enableBrCompress     4
    gzipAutoUpdateStatic 1
    gzipStaticCompressLevel 6
    brStaticCompressLevel 6
}
